regime_map.title: Regime Map
regime_map.why_it_matters: The macro regime quadrant determines which asset classes face structural headwinds versus tailwinds.

sections.question: Which macro quadrant best describes current cross-asset dynamics?
sections.answer: Data not yet active for this section.
sections.why: Quadrant transitions are more informative than spot levels; direction of dollar and real yield change over 20 days leads equity beta.
